pos.personaBrief: Zagallo's 1970 side kept the ball to tire Italy and 'defended with the ball', but also moved fast and countered through Gerson, without hogging possession.

pro.personaBrief: Gerson launched quick counters, Brazil moved fast, and the system was not built from the keeper, though Piazza was moved back for build-up; direct, fast and safe at the pivot.

est.personaBrief: Five interchanging number tens in a fluid attack, Tostao dropping and Rivellino not a fixed winger, but under a drilled, disciplined system.

lar.personaBrief: An extra central playmaker (Rivellino brought into midfield, five 10s) with Carlos Alberto bombing down the flank; width came from full-backs rather than wingers.

blo.personaBrief: Brazil did not press high or sit deep consistently: a back line pushed to halfway when attacking, but a low 4-4-1-1 block against structured attacks; the heat made pressing unrealistic.

mar.personaBrief: Covering back line with zonal marking in 1974, but Zagallo gave strict individual defensive tasks (Jair tracking the full-back) and the 1970 side marked specific threats.

pla.personaBrief: He changed system and players on arrival, imposing his idea, yet adapted tasks to opponents (Jair told to track the full-back, keeping the ball against man-marking Italy).

res.personaBrief: A winner marked by Feola's defensive cohesion and 'you don't win a World Cup with the trivial of clubs'; he cared about the title and result over beauty.

sis.personaBrief: Discipline and self-sacrifice for everyone, Pele dropping back to help midfield, Tostao sacrificed; the system came first even with stars.

jog.personaBrief: A technically gifted team, but with a 21-day altitude camp for peak fitness and demand that everyone fight and work back.

bas.personaBrief: Brought back experienced players (e.g. the one cut by Saldanha) and relied on seasoned stars; 1974 collapse after retirements, no youth emphasis.

lid.personaBrief: First meeting: 'I want discipline and order, will and self-sacrifice from all of you'; same rules for all, tight control of Jair's duties.
